Freed is available across any device—phone, tablet, or desktop—and integrates with popular EHRs including Athena and eClinicalWorks on desktop. The platform is fully HIPAA, HITECH, and SOC2 compliant. The app is available on both iOS and Android.

Freed operates on a subscription model with a monthly subscription costing approximately $179. A free trial is available for clinicians to test the platform before committing. The company does not collect any user data from the app. Freed is positioned as the tool for clinicians who want a simpler, faster alternative to traditional dictation services, with a focus on allowing doctors to 'leave work at work' and reclaim their weekends.
benefits: Extremely simple workflow: one 'Capture' button generates a complete SOAP note instantly—no complex setup, training, or workflow changes required
Available on both iOS and Android (unlike competitor Abridge), plus desktop, making it accessible across the full range of clinician devices
Can be trained to learn each clinician's individual style and preferences, improving accuracy and personalization over time
drawbacks: Pricing is steep at approximately $179/month, which may be prohibitive for individual clinicians or small practices
As an ambient AI scribe, it requires a clear audio environment; noisy clinics or overlapping speech may impact accuracy
Android app may not be available in all regions; users should confirm availability in their country's Google Play Store

apps.name: Collate
apps.desc: AI-native data governance and catalog platform built on OpenMetadata for enterprise data discovery and lineage.
apps.overview:
Collate is the AI-for-data platform built by the creators of OpenMetadata, the open semantic context layer for AI. The platform addresses a fundamental problem in enterprise data: LLMs identify the right data for a given prompt only about 10% of the time, making AI a non-starter for serious data applications. Collate 2.0 (announced June 2026) fixes this by giving AI agents semantic context—not just context (what data exists) but semantics (what it means) and memory (making knowledge persistent and shareable).

With Collate 2.0, data professionals can tag, classify, document, curate, search, and analyze data by simply describing what they want conversationally. The platform's semantic context graph boosts data agent accuracy by as much as 7x in benchmarks. The platform uses more than 130 native connectors to map every enterprise data source to a single metadata graph. Collate provides a no-code AI Studio for building custom agents, an AI SDK for programmatic agent development, and five built-in automation templates for common jobs like regulatory compliance tagging, domain assignment, and data quality testing.

Collate also includes a Data Marketplace: an internal storefront for domains and data products with self-serve discovery, governed data product check-out, and end-to-end Data Access Request Workflows. The platform is backed by Venrock, Unusual Ventures, and Karman Ventures, and is used by Global 2000 companies and innovative startups. Collate 2.0 is scheduled for general availability in July 2026.
benefits: Semantic context graph boosts data agent accuracy by up to 7x—solving the fundamental problem that LLMs identify the right data only ~10% of the time without semantic context
130+ native connectors map every enterprise data source to a single metadata graph, plus a Data Marketplace for governed self-serve discovery
Conversational interface lets data professionals tag, classify, document, search, and analyze data without writing SQL or complex queries
drawbacks: Narrow focus on enterprise data governance and discovery—not useful for general AI work or consumer use
Pricing is not publicly disclosed; requires contacting Collate for a custom quote
The platform is built on OpenMetadata, meaning organizations using other metadata standards may face migration or integration complexity

apps.name: Prepared
apps.desc: Assistive AI platform for 911 emergency communications that transcribes, translates, and surfaces call details in real time.
apps.overview:
Prepared is an assistive AI platform for 911 emergency communications (Public Safety Answering Points, or PSAPs) that turns emergency calls into actionable intelligence and enables faster response. The platform synthesizes call audio, text, video, GPS, and real-time translation into a single view, supporting more than 1,000 agencies across 49 states that protect nearly 100 million people. Prepared's technology is designed to eliminate blind spots in the earliest moments of an emergency and give responders the speed and clarity they need to save lives.

Key features include: AI-powered non-emergency call handling that triages routine inquiries, preserving critical personnel and phone capacity for urgent emergencies; a real-time communication platform that allows dispatchers to send secure links via text for livestream video from caller mobile phones (voluntary participation requiring caller consent); two-way texting capabilities for situations where the caller cannot safely speak; text translation across more than 200 languages; and audio translation in 33 languages.

Prepared was founded in 2019 and initially developed technology to help mitigate school emergencies before identifying gaps in traditional 911 systems. In September 2025, Axon (the global public safety technology leader behind TASER and body cameras) announced it had entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Prepared, integrating the platform into Axon's ecosystem to strengthen its strategy to connect every link in public safety from call to closure. Oneida County, New York, launched both Prepared systems in March 2026, praising them for improving efficiency and expanding capabilities.
benefits: Supports over 1,000 agencies across 49 states protecting nearly 100 million people, with proven real-world deployment
AI-powered call triage, livestream video, and text/audio translation across 200+ languages provide unique, life-saving capabilities unavailable in traditional 911 systems
Acquired by Axon (the public safety technology leader) in September 2025, ensuring long-term stability and integration with the broader public safety ecosystem
drawbacks: Built exclusively for public safety and 911 emergency communications—not applicable to any other industry or use case
Pricing is not publicly disclosed; agencies must contact Prepared or Axon for custom quotes
Video features require caller consent and a smartphone; not all 911 callers will be able or willing to participate

apps.name: Axon
apps.desc: Public safety technology company using AI across body cameras, 911 response, and automated police report drafting.
apps.overview:
Axon (Nasdaq: AXON) is the global leader in public safety technology, evolving far beyond its origins as a TASER manufacturer into a comprehensive technology platform for law enforcement, enterprise security, and national defense . The company's mission is to build a connected picture of safety that helps protect people and places with greater speed, clarity, and accountability. Its ecosystem includes TASER energy devices, body-worn cameras, in-car cameras, drones, counter-drone systems (Dedrone), digital evidence management, real-time operations, immersive training, and AI-driven capabilities .

Axon has become a leading AI provider in public safety, reporting $750 million in sales from its AI product line last year with bookings growing almost 40% . The company's AI suite includes Draft One, which listens to body camera recordings and automatically generates first drafts of police reports, saving officers 20-30% of their time . Other AI tools include Axon Vision for recognizing critical activity in live video feeds, Axon Assistant for secure AI-powered access to case data and BOLO creation, and Axon Gravity for connecting department systems to provide data visualization and real-time insights .

In 2025-2026, Axon completed four major acquisitions: Fusus (CCTV integration), Dedrone (counter-drone), Carbyne (911 communication), and Prepared (emergency call analysis), positioning the company as 'the true operating system of public safety' . The company's Evidence.com platform now manages approximately 40 times as much data as the Netflix library . Beyond law enforcement, Axon has expanded into enterprise security for retailers, logistics providers, hospitals, and data centers . With more than 3,000 attendees at its recent Axon Week conference, the company continues to drive AI adoption across public safety agencies of all sizes .
benefits: Draft One can save officers 20-30% of their time by automating report writing, allowing them to spend more time in the field .
Axon's connected ecosystem integrates body cameras, evidence management, drones, 911 tools, and AI into a single operating system for public safety .
Axon AI is purpose-built for public safety with rigorous bias testing, human-in-the-loop oversight, and CJIS-compliant security .
drawbacks: Built exclusively for public safety, law enforcement, and enterprise security—not applicable to other industries or general AI use .
Pricing is not publicly disclosed; agencies must contact Axon for custom quotes, with contracts often at enterprise scale.
AI effectiveness depends on the quality and volume of data an agency has—smaller departments with limited digital infrastructure may see less dramatic ROI .

apps.name: MagicSchool
apps.desc: AI platform for K-12 educators with 80+ tools for lesson planning, rubrics, and reducing teacher burnout.
apps.overview:
MagicSchool AI is the leading AI platform for K-12 educators, providing a library of over 80 specialized tools designed to save teachers time on administrative and instructional tasks while enhancing classroom instruction . The platform addresses critical pain points in lesson planning, student engagement, and workload management, with tools that can generate lesson plans, create assessments and rubrics, draft professional emails and report card comments, adapt text to different reading levels, and create interactive study aids . It has been adopted by school districts nationwide as their primary AI platform for teachers and students .

A distinguishing characteristic of MagicSchool is its emphasis on accessibility through intuitive design. The platform eliminates the need for complex AI prompting by providing straightforward user interfaces featuring pre-made buttons, dropdown menus, and simplified text fields—making advanced AI capabilities accessible to educators regardless of their technical proficiency . The platform also features 'Raina,' a conversational AI assistant designed specifically for educational contexts, and includes a 'MagicStudent' environment where teachers can create controlled 'rooms' for students to interact with AI tools .

MagicSchool integrates directly with Google Slides for exporting presentations, supports multilingual content generation, and includes features like the 'Text Leveler' tool which can adjust the reading grade of a passage . Teachers can use the platform to brainstorm instructional strategies, differentiate content for diverse learners, and generate accommodations for IEP or 504 plans . The platform operates on a freemium model with a free tier available, though enterprise districts typically deploy through paid accounts accessed via ClassLink or similar portals .
benefits: 80+ specialized AI tools built specifically for educators, covering everything from lesson planning and rubric generation to parent communication and IEP accommodations .
Designed for accessibility with pre-made buttons, dropdown menus, and simplified text fields—teachers don't need to learn complex prompting .
Integrates with Google Slides, Canvas, and other common educational tools, with an intuitive interface that any teacher can start using immediately .
drawbacks: Free tier limits access to some advanced features; full enterprise deployment requires district-level subscriptions .
While it generates lesson plans and materials quickly, teachers must still review and customize outputs for their specific classroom needs .
Student-facing tools require teacher-created 'rooms' with access links, adding an administrative step before students can use the platform .

apps.name: SchoolAI
apps.desc: Classroom AI platform where teachers build interactive AI 'Spaces' for personalized student learning and insights.
apps.overview:
SchoolAI is a classroom AI platform founded in 2023 by former Apple instructional designer Caleb Hicks, designed to help teachers provide personalized learning at scale . The platform has reached 1 million classrooms across 80+ countries and is embedded in over 500 education partnerships . Built on OpenAI models including GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, image generation, and text-to-speech, SchoolAI translates cutting-edge AI into classroom-ready tools that teachers report save 10+ hours per week .

SchoolAI's agent architecture revolves around two core components: 'Spaces' (interactive learning environments created by teachers through the 'Dot' conversational assistant) and 'Sidekick' (an AI tutor that adapts to how students learn, offering guidance, pacing, and encouragement based on their responses) . Teachers can type something like 'create a differentiated reading activity for students at three different levels,' and Dot assembles a ready-to-use lesson in seconds . Unlike simple chatbots, every student interaction runs through an agent graph with dozens of specialized nodes that call models, tools, or guardrails before returning an answer—ensuring students receive structured support that reinforces real learning rather than just getting answers .

A key differentiator is SchoolAI's teacher-in-the-loop architecture: every student interaction is observable, giving teachers proactive insight into what students need before small gaps become bigger ones . Built-in guardrails help ensure safe, transparent, and classroom-aligned AI use. One cited example involved a student newly arrived in the US who only spoke Dari—within weeks of using Sidekick for real-time translation, he was participating in group work and building friendships . The platform serves teachers, students, and administrators, with real-time instructional data that school leaders use to understand what's working and where to invest support . SchoolAI is available with a free tier and operates on a freemium model for expanded features .
benefits: Teachers report saving 10+ hours per week by using SchoolAI for lesson creation, differentiation, and personalized student support .
Spaces and Sidekick architecture ensures AI coaches students rather than just giving answers—every interaction is designed to reinforce learning .
Full teacher visibility into every student interaction enables early intervention before small gaps become major learning setbacks .
drawbacks: Building sophisticated Spaces requires some setup time; while Dot speeds lesson creation, teachers need to invest initial effort in designing their AI environments .
Fully leveraging the platform's personalization capabilities requires teachers to integrate it consistently into their classroom workflow .
As a relatively young platform (founded 2023), SchoolAI has less established track record than some legacy education technology providers .

apps.name: CoreWeave
apps.desc: Specialized cloud provider offering large-scale NVIDIA GPU infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads.
apps.overview:
CoreWeave is a specialized cloud provider purpose-built for AI and compute-intensive workloads, offering access to NVIDIA GPUs on a cloud infrastructure that is reportedly up to 35x faster and 80% less expensive than general-purpose clouds . The company has been named NVIDIA's first Elite Cloud Services Provider for Compute, reflecting its deep partnership with NVIDIA and its ability to deliver world-class solutions for AI, ML, HPC, and rendering use cases . CoreWeave Cloud provides over 10 NVIDIA SKUs, allowing clients to access the specific GPU types purpose-built for their use case rather than accepting a 'one size fits all' approach .

CoreWeave's cloud platform is Kubernetes-native and designed for AI workloads from the ground up, featuring bleeding-edge bare-metal infrastructure, automated provisioning, and support for leading workload orchestration frameworks . The platform offers compute, storage, networking, managed software services, and cluster health management—all optimized for AI training and inference . Key performance metrics include 10x faster inference spin-up times and 96% cluster goodput, with fewer interruptions and near-real-time issue resolution .

The company has scaled its fleet across multiple GPU architectures including NVIDIA H100, A100, A40, and others, with one of the largest deployments of NVIDIA A40 GPUs in North America . CoreWeave is used by AI companies, research institutions, and enterprises requiring high-performance GPU infrastructure for training large language models, running inference at scale, batch processing, and pixel streaming . Pricing follows a cloud consumption model with transparent, predictable costs designed to be significantly lower than general-purpose clouds .
benefits: NVIDIA's first Elite Cloud Services Provider for Compute, reflecting deep partnership and early access to the latest NVIDIA GPU technology .
Up to 35x faster and 80% less expensive than general-purpose clouds for AI and compute-intensive workloads .
Kubernetes-native platform with 10+ NVIDIA GPU SKUs, automated provisioning, and 96% cluster goodput for production-ready AI workloads .
drawbacks: As a specialized cloud, CoreWeave may not offer the full breadth of services (e.g., managed databases, analytics, serverless functions) available on general-purpose clouds like AWS or Azure .
Pricing is consumption-based and may not be suitable for teams with limited budgets or unpredictable workloads .
The platform's GPU focus means it's less suitable for traditional web applications or workloads that don't require significant GPU acceleration .

apps.name: Nebius
apps.desc: AI-centric cloud platform providing GPU compute clusters, managed infrastructure, and tools for training large models.
apps.overview:
Nebius AI Cloud is an AI-centric cloud platform providing high-performance infrastructure for machine learning training and inference workloads . The platform offers a comprehensive suite of services for AI development including virtual machines with NVIDIA GPU support, GPU clusters connected via InfiniBand networks for high-speed distributed computing, Slurm workload manager clusters for ML/AI experiments, and Kubernetes clusters with GPU and InfiniBand support .

Beyond compute, Nebius provides object storage (AWS S3-compatible) for ML/AI datasets and model artifacts, managed PostgreSQL database clusters, and a container registry for Docker image storage . The platform also offers specialized AI services including Serverless AI (containerized inference endpoints and background jobs), managed MLflow clusters for experiment tracking and model registry, and turnkey applications like JupyterLab, vLLM, and Open WebUI . Third-party integrations support running and orchestrating AI workloads with tools like SkyPilot and Run:ai .

Nebius is designed for developers, data scientists, and ML engineers who need scalable, high-performance infrastructure for training and deploying AI models . The platform includes observability tools (metrics and alerts, logs, traces), identity and access management, comprehensive documentation, and support for Terraform and CLI tools . The platform is GDPR-compliant with features for data portability and deletion . Pricing follows a cloud consumption model with transparent costs for compute, storage, and networking resources .
benefits: Comprehensive AI infrastructure platform with GPU compute, high-speed InfiniBand networking, Slurm and Kubernetes clusters, and managed MLflow .
Serverless AI endpoints and background jobs for containerized inference and training, plus turnkey applications like JupyterLab and vLLM .
S3-compatible object storage and third-party integrations (SkyPilot, Run:ai) make it easy to migrate existing AI workloads .
drawbacks: As a specialized AI cloud, Nebius may not offer the breadth of general-purpose cloud services available on AWS, Azure, or GCP .
Pricing is consumption-based; teams should model expected GPU usage before committing to a deployment .
The platform's focus on AI/ML means it's not suitable for traditional web applications or non-AI workloads .

apps.name: Crusoe
apps.desc: Vertically integrated AI cloud offering GPU compute powered by stranded and clean energy sources for large-scale training.
apps.overview:
Crusoe is a vertically integrated AI cloud platform that distinguishes itself by powering high-performance computing infrastructure with clean, renewable, and stranded energy sources . The company was founded in 2018 with an energy-first approach: rather than bringing power to data centers, Crusoe brings data centers to energy production sites, minimizing grid strain while reducing emissions . This approach has been recognized with Crusoe being named Cloud AI Company of the Year 2025 .

The company's AI cloud platform uses NVIDIA H200, H100 SXM, A100 SXM GPU instances with NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand networking to accelerate distributed training on clusters ranging from 8 to over 8,000 GPUs . For scalable inference, Crusoe employs NVIDIA H200, H100, L40S, A100, and A40 GPUs, enabling 20B+ parameter model inference on a single card . Leading Fortune 500 companies rely on Crusoe's advanced, AI-optimized cloud to support their most demanding AI applications .

Crusoe has made significant infrastructure investments including a $3.4 billion joint venture with Blue Owl Capital and Primary Digital Infrastructure announced in October 2024 to accelerate AI data center development . In July 2024, Crusoe unveiled plans for an initial 200 MW AI data center at Lancium Clean Campus with expansion plans already in place . The company also participates in STEM education initiatives, hackathons, and partnerships to foster AI innovation . Crusoe's vertical integration enables faster deployment of state-of-the-art capacity than legacy cloud providers, with the company's CEO stating they can deploy new infrastructure in 'a fraction of the time' of competitors .
benefits: Vertically integrated AI cloud with access to NVIDIA H100, H200, and A100 GPUs on clusters up to 8,000+ GPUs with InfiniBand networking .
Powered by clean, stranded, and renewable energy sources, delivering high-performance computing with significantly lower emissions .
$3.4 billion joint venture and 200 MW data center investments demonstrate serious long-term commitment to scaling AI infrastructure .
drawbacks: Pricing is not publicly disclosed; requires contacting Crusoe for custom quotes .
The energy-first model means data center locations may be remote or not ideal for all latency-sensitive workloads .
As a specialized AI cloud, Crusoe may not offer the broad set of general-purpose services available from AWS, Azure, or GCP .
